title: World's Best Oreo Fudge
description: Oreo fudge made with chocolate sandwich cookies folded into sweet marshmallow fudge is the perfect treat for gifting over the holidays.
ingredients: 0.5 cup crumbled chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo®)
1 cup crushed chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo®)

steps.text: Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper; set aside.
Bring sugar, butter, and evaporated milk to a boil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan, stirring constantly; cook and stir at a boil until mixture is smooth, 3 to 5 minutes.

Remove the saucepan from heat. Mix in white chocolate chips and marshmallow creme until melted, then stir in vanilla. Fold in 1/2 cup crumbled cookies until just incorporated. Spread fudge into the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle 1 cup crushed cookies evenly over the top. Press crushed cookies lightly into fudge. Cool at room temperature until set, then cut into small squares to serve.

video.description: Oreo® cookie lovers the world over agree that you’ll love this fudge! And it’s easy to make, too! Boil together sugar, butter and evaporated milk, stir in white chocolate chips and marshmallow crème until melted and finish with vanilla. Mix in crushed chocolate sandwich cookies, spread into a pan, then top with more crushed cookies. That’s it! Wait for it all to set, then get set cutting into squares and serving to the joy of all and anyone who’s ever craved cookies or fudge, which is pretty much everyone. This creamy indulgent cookie candy mashup will be a great hit on your holiday cookie and candy trays, but is perfectly acceptable as a housewarming or hostess gift, a tempting addition at a potluck, or used to win cookie points with someone you’re hoping to sweeten up.
